title: Strict semilinear point transport and descent to whole derived systems
statement:
Fix $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, its algebraic closure $k$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. Set $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, let $h=\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ for geometric Frobenius [def-trf-scheme-frobenius], and on the small pro-etale site set $B_n=(A_n)_s$ and $\widehat R_s=\lim_nB_n$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Let $\mathscr S_s$ be the abelian category of strict $B_n$-module systems with quotient-linear transitions, with its ordinary unbounded derived category [lem-coef-semilinear-derived-sections]. Write $U_s$ for levelwise restriction to $\widehat R_s$-module towers and $\mathcal L_s=R\lim U_s$ [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Put $F_r=(h^r)^{-1}$ on module complexes with scalars transported through the canonical coefficient isomorphisms, and $G_r$ for its levelwise functor on systems [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image, def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. Read the finite levels through $j_{r,M}:F_rM\to(h^r)^*M$, $x\mapsto x\otimes1$, of part (a) of the latter definition. Let $\Gamma_\bullet$ be restriction of scalars followed by exact sections levelwise, retaining all transitions [def-trf-coefficient-tower-operations, lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact].

For $r\geq1$ and every complex $M$ of strict systems there is a unique natural $R$-linear chain map of strict towers
$$u_{r,M}:\Gamma_\bullet M\longrightarrow\Gamma_\bullet G_rM$$
whose $n$th component is $\Gamma(s,j_{r,M_n})\sigma_{r,M_n}$, where $\sigma$ is restriction along $h^r$ followed by inverse-image colimit insertion and sheafification in the recipe [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. In the site-reindexing model $(F_rM_n)(V\xrightarrow v s)=M_n(V\xrightarrow{h^r v}s)$ the insertion identifies this $\sigma$ with the actual restriction at the final object. It is $A_n$-linear for the specified coefficient action; $j_{r,M_n}$ is an isomorphism with inverse $x\otimes a\mapsto c_n^{-1}(a)x$, where $c_n:F_rB_n\cong B_n$ is the coefficient isomorphism. For a transition $v_n:M_{n+1}\to\operatorname{Res}M_n$, writing $\rho_n:B_{n+1}\to B_n$ for coefficient reduction, the tensor-insertion square has formula $x\otimes1\mapsto v_n(x)\otimes\rho_n(1)=v_n(x)\otimes1$, with completed scalar compatibility $\pi_nc_{\widehat R}=c_nF_r(\pi_n)$. These components commute with differentials and the original transitions. For every chain map $f:M\to M'$ one has
$$\Gamma_\bullet(G_rf)u_{r,M}=u_{r,M'}\Gamma_\bullet(f).$$
The two exact complex functors preserve quasi-isomorphisms and this specified transformation descends to
$$I_{r,C}:\Gamma_\bullet C\longrightarrow\Gamma_\bullet G_rC,\qquad C\in D(\mathscr S_s).$$
For every morphism $f:C\to C'$ in this derived SYSTEM category,
$$\Gamma_\bullet(G_rf)I_{r,C}=I_{r,C'}\Gamma_\bullet(f).$$
When $C_n$ is bounded constructible, its $n$th evaluation, through $j_r$, is exactly $\iota^{(r)}_{C_n}$ of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport]. No cartesianness, boundedness or Tor-amplitude condition on the system is required.
